headline: Vale confirms no emergency-level structures in Itabira following regulatory checks
summary: Mining regulator ANM confirmed that Vale has no structures at emergency levels in Itabira, Minas Gerais, after reinforcement work was completed on the Minervino dike.
why: Vale is one of the world's largest mining companies, and safety compliance at its tailings dams is critical for operational continuity.

impacts.name: Vale
impacts.why: Regulatory confirmation of stable dam structures ensures continued operations in Itabira.
